symbolizer.prompt: A modern high-resolution colour aerial orthophoto of the Po delta lowlands near Comacchio, shot from a light aircraft on a clear morning in late spring. Photographic, not illustrated: true-to-life colour, natural daylight, soft shadows with visible direction, fine grain and real photographic depth. The neutral ground between the mapped units is intensively cultivated farmland — green and gold field parcels in different crop stages, ploughed brown strips, straight drainage ditches, narrow white farm tracks, lines of poplar windbreaks, the occasional red-roofed farmhouse. Rich saturated colour throughout.

control._comment: Every colour is the material's own natural colour, not a legend colour. See the README note on choosing control colours: saturated keys survive into the output as flat overlay; natural ones get repainted, and a region the model declines to repaint still lands on a plausible tone.

Cordoni.describe: a beach ridge of pale dry sand, slightly raised, parallel to the old shoreline; bleached sandy soil showing through thin grass

Dossi.describe: a raised sandy dune ridge — pale warm sandy soil, dry grass and sparse scrub, standing a little above the surrounding fields

Dossi (Valle Pega).describe: a low sandy rise under cultivation, paler than the fields around it

Paleoalvei.describe: a silted-up former river channel — dark damp olive clay, sinuous, holding moisture and darker vegetation than the fields

Linea di costa.describe: shallow brackish lagoon water — teal-green, calm, with pale sandy shallows near the shore

Ustrina (aree).describe: a burnt cremation area — scorched dark red-brown earth, bare of vegetation

Palificazioni (legno).describe: waterlogged timber piling at the water's edge — dark wet wood and reed

Abitato.describe: a low earthen settlement mound, beaten pale ground with dry grass

Passerelle.describe: a narrow raised timber walkway over wet ground
